The figure is 8 x 5 inches and is saved at 150 dpi as figure.png.

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > plot.py <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = np.linspace(0, 10, 201)
f1 = np.exp(-0.5*t)
f2 = np.exp(-t)
f3 = 0.5*np.exp(-2*t) + 1e-4

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(t, f1, color='#1b9e77', linestyle='-', marker='o', markevery=20, linewidth=2, label='exp(-0.5t)')
ax.plot(t, f2, color='#d95f02', linestyle='--', marker='s', markevery=20, linewidth=2, label='exp(-t)')
ax.plot(t, f3, color='#7570b3', linestyle='-.', marker='^', markevery=20, linewidth=2, label='0.5exp(-2t)+1e-4')

ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylim(1e-5, 2)
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.legend(loc='lower left')
ax.set_xlabel('t (s)')
ax.set_ylabel('amplitude')
ax.set_title('Three decays on a log scale')
ax.grid(True, which='major', linestyle=':')

fig.savefig('figure.png', dpi=150)
EOF
python plot.py && ls -l figure.png && python -c "from PIL import Image; im=Image.open('figure.png'); print(im.size)""}
